user.title: Add an OVOS skill
user.description: Pick a skill from the official OVOS catalog to install.

reconfigure_fields.title: Skill settings
reconfigure_fields.description: This skill's settingsmeta.json only uses field types we've confirmed how to map to a real form (checkboxes).

abort.no_api_url: Set the "Skills API URL" text field (under the OpenVoiceOS integration's own entities) to your ovos-skills add-on's address first, e.g. http://<hostname>:8500.
abort.catalog_unreachable: Could not reach the skill catalog via the configured Skills API URL.
abort.unknown_skill: That skill could not be found in the catalog.
abort.install_request_failed: Could not start the install — check that the ovos-skills add-on is running and the Skills API URL is correct.
abort.settings_write_failed: Could not save settings — check that the ovos-skills add-on is running and the Skills API URL is correct.
abort.no_settings_available: This skill doesn't have any settings that can be edited here yet. That usually means it hasn't loaded and saved its own settings file yet -- try again in a minute, or after restarting the ovos-skills add-on.
abort.install_timed_out: The install is taking longer than expected (over 3 minutes). It may still finish in the background — check the ovos-skills add-on's log, then try adding this skill again.

user.title: Autoconfigure text-to-speech & speech-to-text
user.description: Automatically picks a text-to-speech and speech-to-text engine for a language, based on whether you want it to work offline or online, and a male or female voice. This writes into the settings your TTS/STT/wake word add-ons already read, so they'll use it the next time they restart. Setting up each add-on's own 'plugin' field directly, or editing the shared config file by hand, both still work exactly as before -- this is just a guided shortcut to the same setting.

abort.no_core_api_url: Set the "Core API URL" text field (under the OpenVoiceOS integration's own entities) to your ovos-core add-on's address first, e.g. http://<hostname>:8500.
abort.core_unreachable: Couldn't reach the ovos-core add-on at the configured Core API URL. This feature needs ovos-core installed and running.
abort.autoconfigure_failed: Something went wrong picking a text-to-speech/speech-to-text engine. Check that the ovos-core add-on is running and the Core API URL is correct.
abort.autoconfigure_nothing_found:
No text-to-speech/speech-to-text option was found for **{lang}** with that combination.

Try a different voice mode or gender, or leave voice gender unset.
abort.autoconfigure_success:
Set up for **{lang}**.

- Text-to-speech: `{tts_module}`
- Speech-to-text: `{stt_module}`

Restart the TTS/STT add-ons to use these. If either one doesn't start afterwards, add its name under that add-on's own "Extra pip packages" setting.

user.title: Choose active solvers
user.description: Pick which question-answering engines the persona tries, and in what order (the first one that answers wins). This writes directly into the ovos-persona add-on's own configuration and restarts it to apply.

abort.no_persona_api_url: Set the "Persona API URL" text field (under the OpenVoiceOS integration's own entities) to your ovos-persona add-on's address first, e.g. http://<hostname>:8338.
abort.persona_unreachable: Couldn't reach the ovos-persona add-on at the configured Persona API URL. This feature needs ovos-persona installed and running.
abort.no_solvers_found: No solver plugins were found installed in the ovos-persona add-on -- nothing to choose from yet.
abort.settings_write_failed: Could not save the solver list -- check that the ovos-persona add-on is running and the Persona API URL is correct.
abort.persona_success: Done. Active solvers, in order: {solvers}.{fallback_note} The ovos-persona add-on has restarted to apply this.
